overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2x Long OSCR ETF (OSCX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of Oscar Health, Inc. (NYSE: OSCR), less fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements OSCX was launched on Sep 24, 2025 and is issued by Defiance.
